title: Canonical coefficient-line pullback and composition
statement: The canonical roots-of-unity inverse-image comparison induces an isomorphism on the coefficient line, with its pure-generator adjunction equation. These isomorphisms satisfy the canonical identity and composition equations.

source.place: Tag 03PK; finite Tate line and tensor powers. Categorical coherence is proved from the existing source integer tensor family and pullback adjunction APIs.

from.place: Construction of the root cover, scalar extension and signed tensor comparisons

proof.text: Compose the sheafification Hom equivalence with the scalar-extension adjunction. Identify additive maps between ZMod modules with linear maps to obtain lineHomEquiv. Compute the equivalence on pure generators and prove its compatibility with postcomposition.

Combine the two pullback adjunctions with the identity comparison between forgetting modules and direct image. The inverse of this Hom equivalence defines the line pullback map from the given roots comparison. Its postcomposition maps are bijective, so Yoneda gives its invertibility. The same equivalence yields the generator equation.

Transpose the composite using the unit form of upperStarComp. Naturality of lineHomEquiv and the existing roots composition equation identify the transposes. Injectivity gives composition. The composition equation for two identities and naturality of upperStarId then give the identity equation by cancellation.

theorem finiteEtaleTateLine_pullback_normalized
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (hA : (m : A) = 0) :
    ∃ c : ∀ {T T' : Scheme.{u}} (v : T' ⟶ T), IsUnit (m : Γ(T, ⊤)) →
        ((Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) v).obj (finiteEtaleTateLine T m A hA) ≅
          finiteEtaleTateLine T' m A hA),
      (∀ {T T' : Scheme.{u}} (v : T' ⟶ T) (hT : IsUnit (m : Γ(T, ⊤)))
          (W : T.Etaleᵒᵖ) (a : A) (z : (T.rootsOfUnitySheaf m).obj.obj W),
        ((Etale.upperStarLowerStarAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) v).homEquiv _ _
          (c v hT).hom).hom.app W (finiteEtaleTateOneGenerator A m T hA W a z) =
        finiteEtaleTateOneGenerator A m T' hA
          ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ v).op.obj W) a
          (((Etale.upperStarLowerStarAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} v).homEquiv _ _
            (upperStarRootsOfUnitySheafToRootsOfUnitySheaf m v)).hom.app W z)) ∧
      (∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) (hT : IsUnit (m : Γ(T, ⊤))), c (𝟙 T) hT =
        (Etale.upperStarId (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) T).app (finiteEtaleTateLine T m A hA)) ∧
      (∀ {T T' T'' : Scheme.{u}} (v : T' ⟶ T) (w : T'' ⟶ T')
          (hT : IsUnit (m : Γ(T, ⊤))) (hT' : IsUnit (m : Γ(T', ⊤))),
        c (w ≫ v) hT = (Etale.upperStarComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) w v).app _ ≪≫
          (Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) w).mapIso (c v hT) ≪≫ c w hT')
